title: Reviewer report: RV-02 setup-python dependency update
rationale: The pinned diff consistently changes actions/setup-python from v6 to v7 in CI and release workflows, but the supplied implementation evidence does not provide reproducible results for that changed execution path. The infrastructure/deployment test-matrix requirements therefore remain unclosed.
scope_architecture: The complete pinned diff changes only the actions/setup-python reference in three CI workflow steps and one release workflow step. It does not change application ownership, schemas, runtime defaults, persisted or public fields, environment variables, privilege boundaries, or physical-control paths.

findings.finding: The supplied report names only generic historical CI validation and provides no reproducible result for the changed actions/setup-python v7 execution path.
findings.evidence: The infrastructure/deployment matrix requires baseline and appropriate config or release checks, while the supplied automated evidence contains neither commands nor job results for the changed CI and release workflow steps.
findings.impact: An unavailable or incompatible action version could leave CI or release automation unable to provision Python without evidence identifying the affected workflow or runner.
findings.required_change: Record reproducible successful validation for every changed CI and release workflow step, including the runner or job context and outcome.
findings.suggested_test: Run the changed CI and release workflow jobs on their configured runners and retain the job results with the implementation report.

contract_consumer_review: No server data contract changes. The directly affected consumers are the three CI setup steps and the release setup step shown in the pinned diff; all require execution evidence because each now resolves actions/setup-python@v7.

evidence_matrix.check: Pinned git diff SHA-256 for revision 6ed02f5

operations_safety_security_privacy: The reviewed diff adds no credentials, paths, ports, runtime configuration, deployment topology, external export, database, hardware, or physical-action behavior. No risk flag beyond infrastructure/deployment classification is indicated by the supplied artifacts.
documentation_assessment: No documentation or external data contract update is required by the observed reference-only workflow change. The missing validation record must be added to the implementation evidence rather than inferred from the version bump.
limitations: This oracle-blind review was restricted to the mandatory stable rules, reviewer instructions, report schema, RV-02 case object, and complete pinned diff.
No external CI job logs, runner configuration, or additional test artifacts were supplied for inspection.
